title: MVentXConfiguration
description: Validation schema for MVentX multi-environment configuration store (mventx.json)

version.description: Semantic version of the configuration schema

meta.description: Global metadata and visual preferences for MVentX

title.description: Title rendered at the top of the boot menu

theme.description: Name of the GRUB theme to activate

timeout.description: Boot menu countdown timeout in seconds

default_entry_id.description: Unique ID of the environment selected by default

environments.description: Ordered list of registered boot environments

id.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier for the environment

display_name.description: Human-readable name displayed in the boot menu

iso_path.description: Relative path to the ISO file on the data partition (required if type is iso)

boot_method.description: Identifier matching a registered boot recipe (e.g. linux_generic_loopback, chainload_efi)

enabled.description: Whether this environment appears in the active boot menu

order.description: 1-based index determining display order in the boot menu

description.description: Optional details or release notes about the environment

custom_args.description: Optional custom kernel or bootloader arguments

target_path.description: Target EFI or bootloader path if type is chainload

checksum.description: Optional cryptographic hash for ISO validation
